title: Madrid Residency Rest Day — Midpoint Break After Four Nights; Toy Story 5 Buzz Continues Ahead of June 19 Release
detail: June 4, 2026 is the second rest day of Bad Bunny's 10-night Madrid residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano — a planned break after the completion of the first two back-to-back clusters (May 30–31 and June 2–3) and before Cluster 3 opens on June 6. Four sold-out shows totaling more than 256,000 fans are complete, with the residency roughly at its midpoint (10 nights total). Spanish entertainment media spent June 4 running post-concert features: El Correo Gallego, El Nuevo Día, and Que.es all published expanded coverage of Night 4's headline story — that Spanish cinema had taken over La Casita, with Penélope Cruz (her second visit to the residency), Mónica Cruz, Luis Tosar, and Óscar Jaenada among the celebrity VIP guests, and no musical surprise guest. Meanwhile, continuing buzz surrounded Bad Bunny's upcoming appearance in Pixar's *Toy Story 5* (releasing June 19, 2026): Bad Bunny voices 'Pizza with Sunglasses,' a cool and mysterious forgotten toy in an abandoned backyard shed, recording the role in both English and Spanish. The casting had been announced by Pixar on May 26 via social media, generating sustained coverage ahead of the theatrical premiere. The DtMF World Tour's Madrid cluster schedule resumes June 6–7 (Cluster 3), then June 10–11 (Cluster 4), and closes June 14–15 (Cluster 5). 'DtMF' holds at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs for its 61st consecutive week (chart dated May 30), with the next chart date — June 6 — expected to confirm its 62nd week.
